digraph StorageTopology {
    rankdir=TB
    node [shape=box, style="rounded,filled", fontname="Helvetica", fontsize=10, fillcolor=white]
    edge [fontsize=8, color="#666"]

    subgraph cluster_evs {
        label="EVS 云硬盘 (块存储 RWO)"
        style="filled,rounded"
        fillcolor="#FFF1F0"
        color="#F5222D"
        fontsize=11
        fontcolor="#F5222D"
        margin=14

        evs_essd [label="ESSD 超高IO\n370 Gi (3 PVC)", fillcolor="#FFCDD2"]
        evs_gpssd [label="GPSSD 通用SSD\n48 Gi (4 PVC)", fillcolor="#FFCDD2"]
        evs_sas [label="SAS 拓扑感知\n205 Gi (3 PVC)", fillcolor="#FFCDD2"]
        evs_normal [label="普通IO\n200 Gi (1 PVC)", fillcolor="#FFCDD2"]
    }

    subgraph cluster_shared {
        label="共享文件存储 (RWX)"
        style="filled,rounded"
        fillcolor="#FFF7E6"
        color="#FA8C16"
        fontsize=11
        fontcolor="#FA8C16"
        margin=14

        sfs [label="SFS 文件共享\n1 Gi (1 PVC)", fillcolor="#FFE4B5"]
        sfs_turbo [label="SFS Turbo 极速\n500 Gi (1 PVC)", fillcolor="#FFD591"]
        sfs_nas [label="SFS NAS (废弃)\n1520 Gi (4 PVC)", fillcolor="#D9D9D9", fontcolor="#999"]
    }

    subgraph cluster_obj {
        label="OBS 对象存储 (RWX)"
        style="filled,rounded"
        fillcolor="#E6F7FF"
        color="#1890FF"
        fontsize=11
        fontcolor="#1890FF"
        margin=14

        obs_ilesson [label="OBS ilesson\n课件文件桶", fillcolor="#BAE7FF"]
        obs_hikvision [label="OBS hikvision\nNVR录像桶", fillcolor="#BAE7FF"]
        obs_s3 [label="OBS S3 桶\ntencent-tronclass\n(LMS直连)", fillcolor="#91D5FF"]
    }

    subgraph cluster_consumer {
        label="存储消费者"
        margin=14
        style="filled,rounded"
        fillcolor="#F6FFED"
        color="#52C41A"
        fontsize=11
        fontcolor="#52C41A"

        mysql_w [label="wrpc MySQL x2"]
        dask [label="dask-worker x32"]
        office [label="wrpc-office x13"]
        airflow [label="airflow-* x9"]
        etcd [label="apisix-etcd x3"]
        prom [label="prometheus x2"]
        grafana [label="grafana x1"]
        lms [label="tronclass-web x97"]
    }

    mysql_w -> evs_essd [label="180Gi x2"]
    etcd -> evs_gpssd [label="10Gi x3"]
    prom -> evs_sas [label="100Gi x2"]
    grafana -> evs_sas [label="5Gi"]

    airflow -> sfs [label="日志"]
    dask -> sfs [label="日志"]
    dask -> sfs_turbo [label="中转", color="#FA8C16", penwidth=2]
    office -> sfs_turbo [label="中转", color="#FA8C16", penwidth=2]

    dask -> obs_ilesson [label="读取"]
    office -> obs_ilesson [label="读取"]
    dask -> obs_hikvision [label="NVR下载"]
    dask -> obs_s3 [label="上传结果", style=dashed]
    lms -> obs_s3 [label="S3协议", style=dashed]
}

# CCE 集群技术栈
## LMS 主平台
### Python 3.9
- Flask (Web框架)
- SQLAlchemy (ORM)
- Dramatiq (异步任务)
- APScheduler (定时调度)
- Pandas/Pillow/PyPDF2
- boto/MinIO (S3客户端)
### JavaScript
- Vue.js (前端)
- Angular 1.7 (遗留)
- Webpack 5 (打包)
### 存储方式
- OBS S3 (文件上传)
- 外部 MySQL RDS
- 外部 Redis
- 外部 RabbitMQ
## WRPC 转码引擎
### Python
- Flask (API)
- Airflow (DAG调度)
- Dask (分布式计算)
- Gunicorn (WSGI)
### LibreOffice 7.3
- unoconv (文档转换)
- UNO API
### C/C++ 二进制
- 海康威视 SDK
- 大华 DSS/NVR SDK
- 华为 IVS1800 SDK
- 科达 SDK
### AI 能力
- 腾讯云 OCR/TCI
- 科大讯飞 ASR/OCR
- 捷通华声 ASR/OCR
- 华为云 OCR/ASR
## 其他服务
### Java
- Identity (Keycloak)
- ai-tk (Spring Boot)
- ybk (Spring Boot + RocketMQ)
- Logstash
### Go
- ai-toolbox
- velero
### Python
- switchman
- tc-mgs
- data-push-worker

# WRPC 功能全景（24个 DAG）
## 文档转换（最高频）
- document_convert_dag

  - LibreOffice 7.3 + unoconv
- image_thumbnail_dag
  - 图片缩略图生成
## 视频/音频转码
- video_transcode_dag
  - FFmpeg 4.4.1 多分辨率转码
  - 320p/480p/720p/1080p
- audio_transcode_dag
  - 音频格式转换
- clip_video_quickly_dag
  - 视频快速裁剪
## 录播设备对接（25种下载器）
- capture_ten_transcode_dag（10路录播）
- capture_sync_ten_transcode_dag（同步10路）
- capture_srs_transcode_dag（SRS录制）
- capture_ivs1800_download_dag（华为IVS1800）
- capture_ruijie_download_dag（锐捷）
- capture_ruiqu_transcode_dag（锐取）
- capture_zhongqing_download_dag（中庆）
- capture_three_download_video_dag
- capture_three_video_url_dag
- capture_audio_copy_dag
- capture_device_snapshot_dag
- capture_finder_dag
## AI 内容分析
- ai_generate_asr_media_topic_dag（语音→主题）
- ai_generate_ocr_media_topic_dag（OCR→主题）
- ai_intelligent_caption_recognize_dag（智能字幕）
- 集成: 腾讯/讯飞/华为/捷通华声 4家
## 运维自清理
- airflow_db_cleanup_dag
- airflow_log_cleanup_dag
- failure_archive_dag
- success_archive_dag
